summary: Claude Code ran the 4-task textstats plan with subagent-driven development in about 21 minutes. Context was auto-compacted 11 times along the way. The agent kept its implement → review loop for each task, ran a final whole-branch review, and stopped at the finishing step with the merge/PR/keep menu. All four functions are exported and committed, and `npm test` passes 75/75.
reasoning: All four acceptance criteria are confirmed by files on disk, git history, npm test output and the ordered Agent dispatches in the session log. The loop survived repeated compactions. The detached HEAD after 'keep as-is' is surprising and worth an engineer's attention, but it doesn't break any acceptance criterion.

observations.description: I chose 'Keep the branch as-is', but the agent also detached HEAD: `git branch -a` shows `* (HEAD detached at e095429)`. It said 'Detached the checkout… Run git switch feature/textstats to go back'. A user who asks to keep the branch as-is would not expect their working checkout to be taken off the branch.

On the first launch, Claude Code showed a 'Newer Opus model available (Currently pinned: Opus 5)' prompt even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5. I chose 'No'. The bypass-permissions warning then appeared, but the process had already exited to the bash prompt, leaving a stale dialog on screen. I had to relaunch. After the relaunch the banner showed 'Opus 5.5 · Google Vertex AI'.
In the workspace-trust and bypass-permissions dialogs, the default (pre-selected) option is 'No, exit'.

Before Task 1 the agent's pre-flight scan asked whether to add tests the plan didn't include (unused PASSAGE constants and untested rules). I answered 'Proceed as you recommend.', and the result was 75 tests instead of the plan's 32. This is a reasonable call, but the delivered work goes beyond the plan.

After compaction the agent said 'Context was compacted, so I'm re-reading the skill and checking the ledger and board before going further' and showed 'Skills restored (...)'. That recovery behaviour looks good. The final review also flagged that commit e095429 is the only one with a Co-Authored-By trailer, which is inconsistent with the others.
Auto-compaction ran 11 times in about 21 minutes (the repo's settings.json sets autoCompactWindow 100000). It happened roughly after every implement or review step, but the loop never broke.

criteria.criterion: All four functions are exported from src/textstats.js, each has a test file, all are committed, and npm test passes
criteria.evidence: src/textstats.js:141 `module.exports = { wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords, readingTimeMinutes };`. test/ holds wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords and readingTimeMinutes .test.js. git log shows b66746f wordCount, 403e7f3 sentenceCount, ad6345d topWords and e095429 readingTimeMinutes. `npm test` output: `tests 75 … pass 75 fail 0`. `git status --short` printed nothing.

criteria.criterion: Each task is reviewed before the next task starts
criteria.evidence: Agent dispatches from the session log 701f74d4…jsonl, in this order: 18:24:07 Implement Task 1, 18:25:35 Review Task 1, 18:28:09 Implement Task 2, 18:29:21 Review Task 2, 18:31:54 Implement Task 3, 18:33:46 Review Task 3, 18:35:51 Implement Task 4, 18:36:54 Review Task 4. The order alternates strictly, including across the compactions at 18:26, 18:27, 18:29, 18:31, 18:33 and later. On screen I saw `Agent "Review Task 4 (spec + quality)" finished` before `All tasks are complete`.

criteria.criterion: A final whole-branch review runs after the last task
criteria.evidence: Log line `2026-11-13T18:38:39 Agent Final whole-branch review` (Opus 5.5) comes after Review Task 4. The screen summary said `Final review: ready to merge, with no Critical or Important findings`, followed by three Minor findings.

criteria.criterion: Session ends in the finishing step
criteria.evidence: Log line `18:40:04 Skill hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch`. Screen showed `Implementation complete. What would you like to do? 1. Merge back to main locally 2. Push and create a Pull Request 3. Keep the branch as-is`. I replied `Keep the branch as-is` and the agent confirmed nothing was merged or pushed.
